column1: "The parcel being transferred is exempt from the Dorchester County Subdivision Regulations in accordance with Section 140-4A(4) of Chapter 140 of the Dorchester County Code provided the deed of conveyance for the parcel being transferred to the United States of America, the State or any political subdivision of the State of Maryland or to any public instrumentality is recorded among the Land Record Books of Dorchester County, Maryland within one year from the date of recordation of the plat."
